analysis.of: An analysis — did a re-calibration change fill time: the five figures, the sentence and the before / after / change picture

calc.of: A calculator — an acceptance-sampling plan: what it protects, with its operating-characteristic curve

capability.of: A capability study — thirty fill weights against the limits, the histogram, Ppk and the give-away

changeover.of: SMED — a changeover as a grid: who does each element, internal and external, and what separating them buys back

chart.of: A control chart — forty fill weights against limits set from twenty, the signals, the moving range and the CUSUM

linebalance.of: Line capacity — every station beside the bottleneck as the V-curve, against the target

linestandard.of: Line standard — the line drawn on the board: machines, areas and the people placed on them, the bottleneck faded

linework.of: Line balance — the people's work stacked against takt, the constraint in red

logs.of: A check log — the round: a failed check held open, two done on time, the tiles and the sentence

losses.of: Loss count — a shift's lost minutes: shift by shift against the rate, and where the minutes went

reliability.of: Reliability — stops against watched hours and the running time between them, with MTBF

sampling.of: Work sampling — what two people were doing at random moments: each share with its margin

talk.of: Line Talk — the talk on the line: what was said, a photo, a typed line, and the document asked for

valuestream.of: Value stream map — a line's door-to-door steps by who does them, value added, necessary and waste

video.of: Video study — the filmed line read into the work done at each station
